cost_application: sum(abs(diff(scaled_or_reselected_held_weight))) * cost_bps / 1e4, applied to the gate-scaled (U1/U2) or reselected (U3) T1 book held-weight matrix; the cash leg (SHY) carries no separate transaction cost, consistent with open_composer.research.signal_card.book_returns's own convention on the base book.

cash_leg.return_definition: next-open total return (open[t+1]/open[t]-1 on SHY's own adjusted open series), computed the same way as the book's own ret series (Market.next_open_returns), reused unchanged from run_h20260924_02_momentum_crash_guard.py::load_side_panel.
cash_leg.rationale: Matches this repo's frozen giants-sweep/recent-menu CASH=SHY convention, reused unchanged for consistency with h20260924_02.
